notes:
Inbound from self-serve signup (trial credits used). Early discovery call 2026-03-03. Main contact: CTO (Evan Rhodes) + lead eng (Maya Lin). They run a B2B customer engagement widget embedded in partner apps. Key ask: pick a hosted model profile that balances perceived chat quality with low per-token cost. Team said: "we need something noticeably better than base open LLMs at friendly small prompt sizes (<= 256 tokens) but cost needs to stay under a clear threshold for margins."

Model preferences discussed: Llama-family (7B / 13B), Mistral Instruct variants (7B/8B), Qwen-lite. They repeatedly ask for concrete tradeoffs: expected latency (p95), token costs (est $/1k tokens), and fallback options when capacity spikes. Interested in cheap embedding config for semantic search (dense embeddings for search + rerank).

Security: SOC2 mandatory for procurement; SSO needed for admin console; audit logs for API keys. No on-prem requirement; public cloud hosting OK. Retention: they'd like 30-day logs, option to disable request retention for PII.

CTO quote: "If we can get a tested 7B quantized profile that looks like Mistral quality at 40-60% of the cost of large 13B variants, we're in."

Sales notes: tone is technical, cost-sensitive but product-focused. Self-serve metrics: 2000 tokens/day average during trial, ~1200 API calls (chat) last 7 days. Wants benchmark numbers vs OpenAI gpt-3.5/4 baseline.
